title: Tree views for changes and commits, smaller downloads
summary: The Changes view gets a foldable folder tree where a whole folder stages in one click, commit file trees fold and follow the diff as you scroll, and the downloads are about a third smaller.

features.title: Changes as a folder tree
features.body: The file lists switch between flat and a foldable folder tree. A folder's button stages or unstages everything in it, and ⌘/Ctrl-click picks several files or folders to move them in one go.

features.title: Fold folders in a commit
features.body: Click a folder in a commit's file tree to fold or unfold it.

features.title: File tree follows the diff
features.body: The commit's file tree lights up the file being read and scrolls to keep it in view.

improvements.title: Smaller downloads
improvements.body: Builds are optimised and stripped, and the dmg is compressed with LZMA: about a third smaller.

improvements.title: Faster history rendering
improvements.body: Settings are read without copying them for every history row.

fixes.title: Scrolling past a clicked file
fixes.body: After clicking a file in a commit's tree, the diff could stop scrolling at the rows already measured; it now scrolls through.
